Review (Opus, read-only): clean

Head `af19f32ba`, one commit on `main`. I read the diff and the job graph and permissions of the full `release.yml` at the head. I did not run a workflow.

## Checks

1. **Triggers.** The triggers are still only the `v[0-9]+.[0-9]+.0` tag push and `workflow_dispatch`. `app_run_id` is a second input on the existing `workflow_dispatch` (string, default `''`). No `pull_request`, `pull_request_target` or `schedule` trigger. All jobs are GitHub-hosted. A fork cannot start a dispatch. In the repository, only `release.yml` uploads an artifact named `wasm-app`.
2. **Input handling.** The input goes into scripts only through `env:` (`APP_RUN_ID`). No `run:` script has `${{ inputs.* }}`, and the new test pins this for each `run:` step of `site`. The step "Earlier run of the browser build" checks `^[0-9]+$` before the download. If the value is not digits, the job stops, so the later steps never read a bad value. The `run-id:` of the download is a `with:` value, not a script, so a direct expression there is correct.
3. **Permissions.** `actions: read` is added on the `site` job only. The `site` permissions are exactly `contents: read` and `actions: read`, and the test pins the two. The top-level block (`contents: read`) and all other jobs are not changed. `pages` keeps `pages: write` and `id-token: write`. `publish` keeps `contents: write`.
4. **Unchanged paths.**

   | Path | New steps | `APP_RUN_ID` | Result |
   |---|---|---|---|
   | Tag push | skipped (`inputs.site_only` is null) | `''` | as before |
   | Plain dispatch | skipped (`false`) | `''` | as before |
   | `site_only` without `app_run_id` | skipped (`''`) | `''` | as before: own download skipped (wasm skipped), warning, "not part of this copy" page |
   | `site_only` with `app_run_id` | id check, then download | the id | strict path |

   `publish` is not changed (`!cancelled() && !inputs.site_only && startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/')`). The own-run download step is not changed.
5. **Download from another run.** `actions/download-artifact@v4` with `run-id` reads from the current repository by default. It needs a `github-token` that has `actions: read` on that repository. `${{ github.token }}` with the job permission `actions: read` is sufficient. No PAT and no `repository:` input are necessary.
6. **Fail closed.** This is correct. On this path the dispatcher asks for one app by name. A failed download (no `continue-on-error`), a failed `web/check-app-page.sh` on `/tmp/wasm-app`, or a failed check of the copy at `app/` gives `exit 1`. Then `site` is not `success`, `pages` is skipped, and the deployed site stays as it is. A green run without the requested app would hide the failure. The own-run path keeps its warnings.
7. **Site branch.** `git rev-parse` gives blob `43c59f837` for `.github/workflows/release.yml` at `af19f32ba` and at `origin/site/v0.25.0` (`dbdbc1e59`). The two files are byte-identical. `dbdbc1e59` is one commit on `e41d7129f`, and it changes only `release.yml`.
8. **Test.** `CAMCRAFT_NO_SEED=1 cargo test -p xtask --test release_site_tests -j 6` in a detached worktree of `af19f32ba`: 3 passed. I removed the worktree.
9. **Body.** It has `Process change: yes`, `Changelog: none` and `Refs #3276` with no closing keyword. The PR does not edit `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION`. The decision file has the decided, why, dropped and cost-to-change parts of `docs/decisions/README.md`.

## Notes (not blockers)

- The id check accepts the digits of any run of this repository. `check-app-page.sh` checks the shape of the page, not its origin. Only a collaborator can dispatch, so this is acceptable. A possible hardening: before the download, read `gh api repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/runs/$APP_RUN_ID` and refuse a run whose workflow is not `release.yml` or whose `head_branch` is not a `vX.Y.0` tag.
- The subjects of `af19f32ba` and `dbdbc1e59` start with a UTF-8 BOM (`EF BB BF` before `ci(release):`). The PR body also starts with a BOM. A conventional-commit parser can fail to read the type `ci`. A `ci` commit does not change the version bump, so the effect is small. Do not force-push to remove it. For the next commits, write the message without a BOM (for example `git commit -F -` from a heredoc, not a file from PowerShell 5.1 `Out-File`).
- The artifact of run 44976953856 expires after the retention period, which is 90 days by default. The decision file says this. Do the dispatch before the expiry date.

Coordinator: this workflow and process PR merges when it is reviewed (AGENTS.md). The review that this merge relies on is comment 7076825314 (Opus, read-only, clean, head af19f32ba). `release_site_tests` passes 3 of 3 on this head, and clippy on xtask is clean. It adds no new trigger; the input reaches scripts only through `env:`; `actions: read` is the only added permission. I flag it ready and merge it on head af19f32ba. Nothing is pushed after this flag. A `PROCESS_VERSION` bump follows. The same `release.yml` is on `site/v0.25.0` (dbdbc1e59, blob 43c59f837).
